text:
Avery: Quick watercooler q — if you had to pick one sandwich that best represents your personality, what would it be? 😋 (feel free to be absurd)
Samir: Turkey club. layered, reliable, secretly fussy about toppings. :ok_hand: 
Nia: PB&J. nostalgic, uncomplicated, occasionally gets crumbs everywhere. 🥜🍓
Miguel: Spicy tuna melt with extra jalapeños. loud, unexpected, melts under pressure. :fire: 
Priya: Caprese on ciabatta. minimalist but dramatic when it matters. also: basil is my spirit herb. :leafy_green: 
Jenna: Grilled cheese + pickles. comfort first, with a weird edge. (low-key best breakfast sandwich)
Samir: Also gonna nominate the villain: kale-on-rye. pretends to be healthy but actually judges everyone. :smirk: 
Avery: Haha love these. ops-bot can we make a poll? :laughing: 
ops-bot: Poll created — options: Turkey club / PB&J / Spicy tuna melt / Caprese / Grilled cheese + pickles / Kale-on-rye. React to vote.
Priya: Voted Caprese ✅ — also, if anyone's bringing snacks to the all-hands tomorrow pls @channel so I can plan accordingly.
Miguel: Bringing homemade empanadas. Also, side hustle sandwich idea: "Miguel's Mood Melt". branding pending. :sunglasses: 
Nia: Love the mood melt. Also low-effort follow-up: what beverage pairs with your sandwich? I pair PB&J with milky tea.
Avery: Thread winner: Spicy tuna + iced coffee. Congrats Miguel. :tada:
